weighting_note: Confidence weights per status live in config/core/engine.json. A rumoured project contributes 0.0 to forward supply; under_construction contributes 0.95. Room counts below are NOT summed unweighted anywhere.

projects.name: Six Senses Myoko

projects.name: Lime Resort Myoko - MGallery Collection
projects.room_note: Refurbishment of an EXISTING resort, not new-build. Adds branded capacity but little or no net room supply.
projects.net_supply_note: Refurbishment - treat net new supply as approximately zero pending confirmation of prior room count.

projects.name: PCG Suginohara masterplan
projects.scope_note: Four hotels and two commercial facilities around Suginohara, completion horizon to approximately 2034. Room counts NOT established.
projects.warning: A 2034 horizon at proposed status carries a 0.1 weight. This must NOT be counted as committed supply.
